_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE of the gate-exemption overlay. The live overlay is a private record at monitor/private/gate-exemptions.json (CW_GATE_EXEMPTIONS overrides; absent means no exemption is in force). Append-only log mirroring annotations.json: applied by rollup.mjs as-of rollup time (entry active when at <= now and not expired). An active entry converts a red gate status into an ANNOTATED exempt state in rollup views; the raw gate statuses stay untouched. gate = manifest check id (qg-boot-test | qg-contract-tests | qg-openapi | qg-ci | qg-boot-test-pass); service = service dir name; area = the registry area the service belongs to. Never delete an entry — set expires. Write through bin/exempt.mjs.

exemptions.reason: Synthetic example: an edge router that forwards to downstream services and owns no API surface of its own.
exemptions.expiresReason: re-review if the gateway gains endpoints of its own
